articles.title: Private Browser File Uploads: Object Storage Service and 3-Stage Throughput
articles.description: Short answer: for a marketplace accepting private browser uploads, the least complex design is a direct-to-object-storage upload followed by backend processing and an expiring download URL. Presigning itself is not the cost decision. Storage, API calls, and the throughput behavior of large objects a
articles.content: Short answer: for a marketplace accepting private browser uploads, the least complex design is a direct-to-object-storage upload followed by backend processing and an expiring download URL. Presigning itself is not the cost decision. Storage, API calls, and the throughput behavior of large objects are. My default shortlist is Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, and Google Cloud Storage, with Infrai as a reasonable fourth option when the processing call and worker queue should share the storage credential.
articles.author: RiftG84
